headlines.title: House to leave early, punting Hegseth impeachment vote until after November elections
headlines.description: House lawmakers will leave early for the November midterm elections after Republican leaders cancelled votes for Thursday.

headlines.title: 3 Dead After NBC LA Helicopter Crashes
headlines.description: A NewsChopper Four helicopter crashed while covering a story for NBC Los Angeles, leaving three people killed including the pilot and a beloved photojournalist. The chopper crew had been on assignment covering a deadly bus crash that killed two. NBC’s Steve Patterson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Federal Reserve Poised to Raise Interest Rates: What to Know
headlines.description: With inflation and consumer prices on the rise, Wednesday’s meeting of the Federal Reserve is being closely watched to see what the board will signal about interest rates, now and into the future. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY to break down how the Fed is expected to raise interest rates for the first time since 2023 and for the first time under newly minted chairman Kevin Warsh.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia accuses Houthis of attacking Mecca, warns holy city is a ‘red line’
headlines.description: Saudi Arabia has accused the Iran-backed Houthi rebels of attempting to attack Islam’s holiest city, declaring Mecca a “red line” in the escalating conflict.

headlines.title: Ed Sheeran’s Opening Acts Drop out in Solidarity With Macklemore
headlines.description: Fallout is growing over rapper Macklemore’s removal from Ed Sheeran’s tour with now every one of Sheeran’s music openers and his onstage band announcing that they would no longer take part in the tour. Sheeran is also speaking out, saying “Macklemore coming off tour was the promoter’s decision, it was not mine.” NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Supreme Court pushes back against Trump and GOP ahead of the midterm elections
headlines.description: The Supreme Court’s recent rulings on mail-in ballots and redistricting foreshadow a frosty reception to further attempts to change the rules before the election, experts said.

headlines.title: Apple’s record night and Colbert’s Emmys wins highlight TV in transition
headlines.description: Apple took home a total of 28 trophies, with a record 14 for freshman comedy “Widow’s Bay.”

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: Trump administration spent $9.5B last year on employee leave, driven by DOGE-era cuts
headlines.description: The Trump administration spent $9.5 billion last year on paid administrative leave as it pushed to cut costs, the Government Accountability Office said.

headlines.title: Merriam-Webster gives its dictionary a ‘glow-up’ with 1,400 new words and definitions
headlines.description: Merriam-Webster is giving its dictionary another “glow-up,” adding 1,400 words and definitions.
